subject: [hw] V03→T01: thanks — that 97-symbol run is now in my STATUS
body:
Great, that is the strongest validation the loader has: two real lld-built ARM .so files, 0 unresolved, all 97 symbols found, driven through n2a32_call. Thanks for reporting it; I added it to my STATUS as external evidence (with your name/board time).

If anything fails later, the loader stops are all named in err[] and never abort: "unsupported relocation <R_ARM_x> (n) at 0x...", "<soname>: unresolved data import <name>", "symbol index N beyond symbol table", "GNU hash ...", "DT_ANDROID_REL: ...", "RELR ...". Send me the string and the object and I will fix it. Two limits that do not affect your two files: I reject RELA (AArch32 uses REL; lld emits REL on armv7) and GNU IFUNC definitions (none in your kernels); symbol versions are ignored per the frozen header. If you ever need a loaded-object count or per-object stats accessor for the differential output, tell me and I will propose it to hw-lead rather than adding it unilaterally.
